behavior: GET /seen/{messageId}/{podId} checks whether a seen receipt exists for the specified message and pod. The UI concatenates Message + has been/has not been + seen in pod + podId.
gap: The English keys are sentence fragments composed in a fixed English word order, and “seen in pod” reads as a physical pod/capsule in several locales; the caller behavior is receipt existence for a Pod ID.
proposal: Use complete localized result messages for the positive and negative cases, e.g. “A seen receipt exists for message {messageId} on pod {podId}.” and “No seen receipt exists for message {messageId} on pod {podId}.” Then review all locales in the refactored caller.

behavior: The label is followed by run.scorecard.rawAcoustIdHitCount.
gap: The terse English label does not name the hit/match noun shown by its caller. Proposals use the actual raw-hit count context; consider changing the English key to “Raw AcoustID matches” before a later source-key refresh.
